topic.title: Standalone MCP Web Client Container
topic.shortdesc: User guide for running the standalone reference web chatbot container (mcp-client) using a single Docker command.

section.title: Overview & Usage
section.p: The mcp-client is a standalone web chatbot container designed for users who wish to deploy an independent AI chat client connected to the AST MCP Server. It provides an LLM-agnostic chatbot interface running on port 3200.

ul.li: Single-Command Container Launch — Run the complete client using Docker without installing Node.js or building code.
Pluggable LLM Support — Connects to Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or local Ollama instances.
Theme Customization — Configure Bootswatch themes, dark mode, and navbar styling using simple environment variables.

section.title: Running with Docker
section.p: Launch the standalone chatbot container using a single Docker command:
section.codeblock: # Run the pre-built Docker container on port 3200 docker run -d \ --name ast-mcp-client \ -p 3200:3200 \ -e MCP_SERVER_URL=http://host.docker.internal:4001/mcp \ -e CHAT_BOT_PROVIDER=gemini \ -e GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key \ ghcr.io/jason-fox/ast-mcp-client:latest
section.p: Alternatively, if using Docker Compose profiles:
After launching, open your browser to http://localhost:3200 to start chatting with the AI Assistant.

section.title: User Environment Configuration
section.p: Configure container settings using environment variables or an .env file:

plentry.pd: HTTP port for the web chatbot interface (defaults to 3200).
URL endpoint of the AST MCP Server (defaults to http://localhost:4001/mcp).
Active AI provider: gemini, anthropic, openai, or ollama.
API authentication key when using Google Gemini services.
Bootswatch theme name (e.g. default, journal, darkly, flatly).
Set to true to display expandable details for AI tool execution in chat threads.
